panel.title: Tutor

panel.intro: Ask for a hint when you want one. You get one step at a time.

ladder.locked: The full explanation opens after you submit an attempt.

point.pointing: I marked it on the page.
point.offscreen: It moved off the screen. Scroll back to it, or press “Show me where” again.
point.unavailable: I can’t point at that right now. It is not on this page.
point.stale: The project changed, so that hint no longer fits. Ask again for a fresh one.

robot.hiddenNote: The robot is hidden. All help stays here as text.
robot.notSaved: This choice could not be saved on this device. It applies until you leave the page.

home.title: Not sure where to start?
home.level1: Choose Help me start for a clear first step, or Start on my own to explore freely.
home.level2: Programming is in the middle of the page. PC assembly is at the end.
home.level3: Choose PC assembly to jump to the builder, or Programming to run your first example.

class.assembly: Something in the build needs attention
class.startup_fault: The computer does not start properly
class.operating_load_fault: A problem shows up under load

title.warning: Something to check in the network

journey.symptom: The packet did not arrive. Play its journey step by step: at which device does it stop?

tutor.aiError: The AI assistant cannot be reached right now. Using built-in hints.

announce.selected: {subject} picked up. {available} of {total} places are available. Use the up and down arrows to go through them, Enter to place, Escape to cancel.
announce.selectedNone: {subject} picked up. None of the {total} places can take it right now. Go through the list to hear why.
announce.selectedNowhere: There is nowhere to put {subject} yet.
announce.confirm: Put {subject} in {destination}? Press Enter to confirm, or Escape to go back.
announce.backToList: Back to the list of places for {subject}.

list.keys: Up and down arrows: move. Enter: place. Escape: cancel. Ctrl+Z: undo.

controls.ready: Ready. Press Play, or go step by step.

announce.selected: {subject} picked up. {available} of {total} ports can take it. Use the up and down arrows to go through them, Enter to plug in, Escape to cancel.
announce.selectedNone: {subject} picked up. None of the {total} ports can take it right now. Go through the list to hear why.
announce.selectedNowhere: There is no port for {subject} yet.
announce.confirm: Plug {subject} into {destination}? Press Enter to confirm, or Escape to go back.
announce.backToList: Back to the list of ports for {subject}.

controls.row: Wires in the plug, pin 1 to pin 8
controls.reset: Cut the plug off and start again
controls.keys: Left and right arrows: move between wires. Space: pick a wire up or put it down. While holding a wire, the arrows move it. Escape: put it back.

announce.grabbed: Picked up the {wire} at pin {position}. Left and right arrows move it. Space puts it down. Escape puts it back.
announce.atEdge: The {wire} is already at pin {position}. It cannot go further.
announce.needStandard: Choose T568A or T568B before you crimp.
announce.locked: The plug is crimped, so the wires cannot move. Cut it off to try again.
announce.reset: Plug cut off. The wires are loose again.

ask.label: Ask the tutor a question
ask.placeholder: For example: why doesn't my computer start?
ask.caution: The AI assistant can be wrong. Check its answer against the hints above.
ask.possible: This is a possibility, not a certainty.
ask.error: The AI assistant could not answer. The built-in hints above still work.
ask.discarded: Your project changed while the assistant was thinking, so its answer was dropped. Ask again if you still need it.
ask.busy: The AI assistant has had many questions in a short time. Wait a moment, then ask again. The built-in hints above still work.
